authoritativeSummary.status: Three frozen synthetic workloads passed the 5% stability gates. This is not TypeScript checker speed.
authoritativeSummary.host: Xeon W-1350P · Ubuntu 24.04 under WSL2 · CPU 0

rounds.title: Cut the repeated indexing tax.
rounds.subtitle: Raw multi-pointer table access and cached masks reduced unnecessary checked access. K2's wall time remained slightly above Rust.
rounds.resultNote: Early lab checkpoint. K2 remained above parity; do not promote this round as an all-kernel win.

rounds.title: Smaller isn't always faster.
rounds.subtitle: u32 K2 values helped. Packing K3's four states into two bits added decoding/manipulation cost and regressed wall time.
rounds.resultNote: K3 regressed beyond Rust parity. The packed-state idea was rejected; lower memory footprint alone was insufficient.

rounds.title: The cache wins. The global gate doesn't.
rounds.subtitle: Returning to u8 K3 state with a branch-light steady-state path improved K3 substantially. K2 split-half drift exceeded 5%, so the global run was not stability-qualified.
rounds.resultNote: The K2 global stability gate failed. Ratios are descriptive, not an eligible global benchmark classification.

rounds.title: Compact values, all the way down.
rounds.subtitle: K2's u32 values were carried through the whole hot path, with a cached grow threshold. All three kernels passed the stability gates below Rust parity.
rounds.resultNote: HOTPATH_P4_PARITY_CLEARED — stable sub-1.0 wall ratios for all three checksum-equivalent synthetic kernels.

rounds.title: One fewer bounds edge.
rounds.subtitle: Removed another checked K2 input slice access via a cached raw pointer. K2 improved numerically but did not yet clear the stronger 0.95 ratio target.
rounds.resultNote: HOTPATH_P5_PARITY_CLEARED — stable all-kernel parity, with K2 still at 0.9521× Rust.

rounds.title: A tiny allocation choice with a measurable result.
rounds.subtitle: K2's value backing is write-before-read. Skipping redundant zero-initialization improved its measured wall time without changing input, probing, growth schedule or checksums.
rounds.resultNote: HOTPATH_P6_STRONG — all three kernel ratios satisfied the stronger frozen target and passed all 5% stability checks. projectAction: STOP_P1_AND_REVIEW.

disclaimer: Ratios compare pinned, checksum-equivalent synthetic kernels, not languages in general, and not complete TypeScript checkers.
